comments.label: Reply by Takmilla Tabassum to Takmilla Tabassum's comment 10 years ago
comments.text: I did pad201 with slk last year. I had full in the second mid n so did 6/7 other ppl so u can imagine the level of competition. But in mid1 there were 3 questions that u need to answer reasonably well- u won't find the examples to those 3 in her lectures but she'll mention it in the class but she won't repeat those examples in the review class n some ppl even requested her to check their answers b4 the exam but miss said that it wouldn't be fair. I think I have those 3 answers cuz I helped a friend but she said that she didn't repeat most of the questions that I had marked for her n to get full marks u need to memorize thoroughly to guarantee urself an A. For hk sir well I got full in both the mids n I didn't memorize n besides me only 1 person got full in mid 1 n 2ppl got full on mid 2- others got like 17/18/19/19.5 (this is to give u an idea so that u'll understand better). Secondly I believe that if u skip classes then u won't be able to do very well in pad cuz every class matters as she gives examples n explanations which she can't fully repeat in the review class. But for hk sir- reading the book thoroughly is enough but both the faculties leave 10% for attendance n both of them gives the chance to earn a bonus 1% on attendance (forgot slk mam's technique but hk sir holds seminars at times). Some1 mentioned asz -he's good but to get an A u need to record what he says. I had missed 5/6 classes in pol with edh sir but still ended up with an A- u just need to write a lot in the exams n questions can be managed but he takes unannounced quizzes n I was lucky not to remain absent on those days- he takes 5- 2 b4 mid 1, 1 b4 mid 2 n 2 b4 the final n counts best 4. Hope this suffices

comments.text:
pad 201- slk. undoubtedly she is one of the best faculties. 2 mids, 3 quizes(best 2), one final. will give questions in the review class before exam and exact same questions will appear in exam!! she will give lecture notes and no need to buy any book. questions are clear cut! don't have to write a lot just be precise and you'll get full marks. all the answers are clearly given in the lecture notes. no project no presentation. life's good if you take her!
mgt489- jna is easy going only if u attend his class. if you can write things that he discusses in class you'll get good marks but missing class will be a problem. i missed mid 2 and he took make up exam but it was kinda comprehensive!! most questions came from mid 2 and final syllabus and very few were from mid 1 syllabus. but he is super easy going compared to the other mgt489 faculties!!
